data.gender_notes: Fursah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A moment of pleasure or joy
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fursah means a moment of pleasure or joy. In Islamic culture, it is associated with the blessings of Allah SWT and the joy of the hereafter. The name Fursah carries the meaning “A moment of pleasure or joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fursah usually hope their child will grow to embody a moment of pleasure or joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fursah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: In Islam, the concept of Fursah holds a deeper spiritual meaning. It is a reminder of the transient nature of worldly pleasures and the importance of seeking eternal happiness in the hereafter. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, "The true believer is filled with joy when he hears good news or when good reaches him. And is deeplyDisturbed when he experiences an affliction or when something bad reaches him." (Sahih Muslim). This rejoicing in the divine blessings is a form of worship and a sign of the believer's faith.
